papers.title: Transmission dynamics of Nipah virus in Bangladesh and India, 2001-2026: systematic review and inference on reproduction number, offspring dispersion, and serial interval
papers.translated_title: 孟加拉国和印度尼帕病毒传播动力学，2001-2026年：系统综述及对基本再生数、子代离散和代间隔的推断
papers.author: Kim, S.
papers.summary: Background Nipah virus (NiV) is a priority zoonotic pathogen causing high-fatality outbreaks. Early NiV outbreaks in Malaysia and Singapore had limited transmission beyond spillover events. However, since 2001, NiV outbreaks with person-to-person transmission have occurred in Bangladesh and India, driven by the NiV-Bangladesh genotype and NiV-India genotype. Our study aims to estimate the reproduction number, offspring dispersion, and serial interval governing NiV transmission in Bangladesh and India during 2001-2026. Methods We conducted a systematic review of NiV outbreak investigations in Bangladesh and India, searching PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and grey literature through 28 February 2026. Case-level offspring counts from 27 sources (323 cases across 67 outbreaks) were used as input to a hierarchical Bayesian negative binomial offspring distribution model. The serial interval was estimated by parametric distribution fitting to 137 transmission pairs. We conducted country-specific analysis and performed sensitivity analyses to evaluate the robustness of estimates. Results Pooling across 67 outbreaks, we estimated a median reproduction number of 0.43 (95% CrI: 0.26-0.75), an offspring dispersion parameter of 0.04 (0.03-0.06), and a serial interval of 13.3 days (95% CI: 12.8-13.8). Country-specific median reproduction numbers were 0.47 (0.22-0.98) for India and 0.35 (0.19-0.63) for Bangladesh, and dispersion parameters were 0.03 (0.02-0.06) and 0.05 (0.03-0.09), respectively, indicating marked overdispersion in both settings. Conclusion NiV transmission is self-limiting on average and highly overdispersed, suggesting that a disproportionate share of onward transmission arises from a small number of cases. This epidemiological profile supports targeted containment measures, including contact tracing and quarantine, for effective NiV outbreak control.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 尼帕病毒（NiV）是一种优先关注的人畜共患病原体，可导致高致死率疫情。马来西亚和新加坡早期的NiV疫情在溢出事件之外传播有限。然而，自2001年以来，孟加拉国和印度发生了由NiV-孟加拉基因型和NiV-印度基因型驱动的人际传播NiV疫情。本研究旨在估计2001-2026年孟加拉国和印度NiV传播的基本再生数、子代离散参数和代际间隔。方法 我们对孟加拉国和印度的NiV疫情调查进行了系统综述，检索了PubMed、Embase、Web of Science和灰色文献，截止日期为2026年2月28日。来自27个来源（67起疫情中的323例病例）的病例级子代计数被用作分层贝叶斯负二项子代分布模型的输入。代际间隔通过对137对传播对进行参数分布拟合来估计。我们进行了分国别分析，并进行了敏感性分析以评估估计值的稳健性。结果 汇总67起疫情，我们估计基本再生数中位数为0.43（95% CrI：0.26-0.75），子代离散参数为0.04（0.03-0.06），代际间隔为13.3天（95% CI：12.8-13.8）。分国别基本再生数中位数印度为0.47（0.22-0.98），孟加拉国为0.35（0.19-0.63），离散参数分别为0.03（0.02-0.06）和0.05（0.03-0.09），表明两种环境中均存在明显的过度离散。结论 NiV传播平均而言具有自限性且高度过度离散，提示后续传播的不成比例份额来自少数病例。这一流行病学特征支持采取针对性遏制措施，包括接触者追踪和隔离，以有效控制NiV疫情。

papers.title: Long-term Associations of COVID-19 Severity with Cognition and Mental Health in an Indian Cohort
papers.translated_title: 印度队列中COVID-19严重程度与认知和心理健康的长期关联
papers.author: Biswas, A.
papers.summary: Long-term cognitive outcomes following COVID-19 remain poorly characterized in South Asian populations. We assessed 181 Indian adults---99 with a reported history of COVID-19 at least six months earlier and 82 healthy controls---using standardized tests of working memory, selective attention, and pattern separation, alongside validated mental-health scales. Disease severity was assessed as per WHO guidelines rather than by degree-of-hospitalization, capturing individuals who experienced severe illness outside hospital care. Those with moderate-to-severe COVID-19 showed pronounced working-memory deficits compared with mildly infected and uninfected controls, while selective attention and pattern separation were comparable across groups. Vaccination at the time of infection was associated with better pattern separation, suggesting selective hippocampal protection. Notably, nearly all participants with moderate-to-severe illness reported a complete recovery despite continuing to exhibit measurable cognitive deficits. However, we did not observe any robust differences in affect or in the propensity toward depression and anxiety. Taken together, our findings suggest that hospitalization is an inadequate proxy for disease severity and that subjective recovery is not an appropriate yardstick for assessing Long COVID, underscoring the need for context-sensitive, population-based assessments of post-COVID sequelae.
papers.translated_summary: COVID-19 后的长期认知结局在南亚人群中仍缺乏充分描述。我们使用工作记忆、选择性注意和模式分离的标准化测试，以及经过验证的心理健康量表，评估了 181 名印度成年人——其中 99 人有至少六个月前报告的新冠病毒感染史，82 名为健康对照。疾病严重程度依据 WHO 指南而非住院程度进行评估，从而纳入了那些在医院外经历重症的个体。与轻症感染者和未感染者相比，中度至重度 COVID-19 患者表现出明显的工作记忆缺陷，而选择性注意和模式分离在各组之间相当。感染时接种疫苗与更好的模式分离相关，提示选择性海马保护。值得注意的是，几乎所有中度至重度疾病参与者都报告完全康复，尽管他们仍表现出可测量的认知缺陷。然而，我们在情感或抑郁和焦虑倾向上未观察到任何稳健差异。综上所述，我们的发现表明，住院是不充分的疾病严重程度代理指标，主观康复不是评估 Long COVID 的适当标准，凸显了需要对 COVID 后遗症进行情境敏感、基于人群的评估。

papers.title: Iron homeostasis and endometriosis risk: Genetic evidence for a shared biological link
papers.translated_title: 铁稳态与子宫内膜异位症风险：共享生物学联系的遗传学证据
papers.author: Denner, V. A.
papers.summary: STUDY QUESTION Is genetic liability to endometriosis associated with iron homeostasis, and is this relationship potentially causal? SUMMARY ANSWER Genetic evidence indicates that reduced systemic iron status is associated with increased risk of endometriosis, with evidence of 8 shared genome-wide significant loci and suggestive but inconsistent evidence for causal bidirectional effects. WHAT IS KNOWN ALREADY Endometriosis is a chronic inflammatory condition associated with local iron accumulation within ectopic lesions and peritoneal cavity, resulting from retrograde menstruation and altered iron homeostasis. Epidemiological studies have suggested that women with endometriosis may exhibit reduced systemic iron stores compared to women without endometriosis, reflected by lower circulating ferritin concentrations, although findings have been inconsistent and may be confounded by menstrual blood loss and inflammation. As observational studies cannot distinguish causal relationships from secondary effects or residual confounding, the potential genetic basis linking iron homeostasis and endometriosis risk remains unclear. STUDY DESIGN, SIZE, DURATION We performed genetic analyses using summary statistics from large-scale genome-wide association studies (GWAS) of endometriosis (overall and stage III/IV disease) and five iron biomarkers (serum iron, ferritin, total iron-binding capacity (TIBC), transferrin saturation, and hepcidin). Analyses included genome-wide genetic correlation using linkage disequilibrium score regression (LDSC), identification of shared genetic variants using multi-trait GWAS (MTAG) and bidirectional Mendelian randomisation to evaluate potential causal relationships. PARTICIPANTS/MATERIALS, SETTING, METHODS Iron biomarker summary statistics came from a six-cohort GWAS meta-analysis (HUNT, MGI, SardiNIA, deCODE, Interval, DBDS; N up to 257,953) of blood-derived serum iron, ferritin, transferrin saturation and TIBC (Moksnes et al., 2022). Endometriosis summary statistics came from a 24-study GWAS meta-analysis (60,674 cases, 701,926 controls; European and East Asian ancestry), 12 of which had surgically confirmed cases (Rahmioglu et al., 2023). Genome-wide genetic correlations between iron biomarkers and endometriosis (overall and stage III/IV disease) were estimated using linkage disequilibrium score regression (LDSC), based on summary statistics aligned to the GRCh37 reference genome and restricted to HapMap3 variants. Multi-trait GWAS (MTAG) was applied to each iron biomarker jointly with endometriosis to enhance discovery of genetic loci. Shared loci were functionally annotated using reproductive and iron related tissues from GTEx v8 and blood from eQTLGen expression quantitative trait loci (eQTL) data. Bidirectional Mendelian randomisation (MR) analyses were performed using genome-wide significant variants across multiple clumping thresholds, with inverse-variance weighting (IVW) as the primary method and sensitivity analyses including weighted median, MR-Egger and MR-PRESSO. MAIN RESULTS AND THE ROLE OF CHANCE Genetic correlation analyses suggested that a genetic predisposition to endometriosis is associated with a profile of lower systemic iron availability. Specifically, genetic liability to endometriosis was associated with higher total iron-binding capacity (TIBC; rg=0.16, p=4x10-4), together with lower transferrin saturation (rg=-0.16, p=0.006) and lower ferritin levels (rg=-0.10, p=0.022), findings that are consistent with reduced iron stores. MTAG identified eight additional genome-wide significant loci for endometriosis and eight loci shared with iron biomarkers, including regions implicating coagulation (F5), innate immune response (IL1A), reproductive biology (WNT4), and immune and vascular pathways (e.g. ABO, STAT6). Mendelian randomisation analyses provided limited and inconsistent evidence for a causal relationship between iron status and endometriosis. Although the inverse-variance weighted (IVW) model showed nominal associations between higher ferritin levels and a lower risk of endometriosis (OR = 0.85, 95% CI 0.76-0.94; p = 0.002), and between genetic liability to endometriosis and higher TIBC (OR = 1.02, 95% CI 1.01-1.04; p = 0.006), these findings were not consistently supported by sensitivity analyses. MR-PRESSO identified a small number of pleiotropic variants, but their removal did not materially alter the results. LIMITATIONS, REASONS FOR CAUTION Iron biomarker GWAS included males and females, potentially obscuring female-specific effects. Dataset availability restricted analyses to European ancestry, limiting applicability to other populations, and to overall and stage III/IV endometriosis, precluding assessment of other disease subtypes. Heterogeneity across SNP instruments, reflected by Cochran's Q statistics, reduced the precision of Mendelian randomisation estimates. Moreover, the genetic instruments explained only between approximately 1.0% and 18.8% of variance in the iron biomarkers, depending on the clumping threshold, which may have limited power to detect causal effects. WIDER IMPLICATIONS OF THE FINDINGS These findings suggest that endometriosis is genetically associated with reduced systemic iron availability and altered iron homeostasis. Thus, lower systemic iron status observed in women with endometriosis may not be explained solely by menstrual blood loss or dietary factors, but reflect an underlying genetic predisposition. Shared genetic loci implicate coagulation, ABO biology, and immune pathways as potential mechanisms linking iron metabolism and endometriosis. Although Mendelian randomisation did not provide consistent evidence for causality, these findings support a shared genetic architecture and warrant further investigation using female-specific GWAS, refined disease subtypes, and multi-omic approaches. Clinically, these findings suggest that low systemic iron status in women with endometriosis may reflect factors beyond established causes of iron deficiency, including an underlying genetic predisposition.
papers.translated_summary: 研究问题 子宫内膜异位症的遗传易感性是否与铁稳态相关，且这种关系是否具有潜在因果性？摘要回答 遗传学证据表明，全身铁状态降低与子宫内膜异位症风险增加相关，存在8个共享的全基因组显著位点，以及提示性但不一致的因果双向效应证据。已知背景 子宫内膜异位症是一种慢性炎症性疾病，与异位病灶和腹膜腔内局部铁蓄积相关，由经血逆流和铁稳态改变所致。流行病学研究表明，与无子宫内膜异位症的女性相比，子宫内膜异位症女性可能表现出全身铁储备降低，反映为循环铁蛋白浓度较低，尽管研究结果不一致，且可能受到月经失血和炎症的混杂影响。由于观察性研究无法区分因果关系与继发效应或残余混杂，连接铁稳态与子宫内膜异位症风险的潜在遗传基础仍不清楚。研究设计、规模、持续时间 我们利用大规模全基因组关联研究（GWAS）的汇总统计数据进行遗传学分析，涵盖子宫内膜异位症（总体及III/IV期疾病）和五种铁生物标志物（血清铁、铁蛋白、总铁结合力（TIBC）、转铁蛋白饱和度和铁调素）。分析包括使用连锁不平衡评分回归（LDSC）进行全基因组遗传相关性分析，使用多性状GWAS（MTAG）识别共享遗传变异，以及双向孟德尔随机化以评估潜在因果关系。参与者/材料、设置、方法 铁生物标志物汇总统计数据来自一项六队列GWAS荟萃分析（HUNT、MGI、SardiNIA、deCODE、Interval、DBDS；N高达257,953），涵盖血液来源的血清铁、铁蛋白、转铁蛋白饱和度和TIBC（Moksnes等，2022）。子宫内膜异位症汇总统计数据来自一项24项研究GWAS荟萃分析（60,674例病例，701,926例对照；欧洲和东亚血统），其中12项研究具有手术确诊的病例（Rahmioglu等，2023）。使用连锁不平衡评分回归（LDSC）估计铁生物标志物与子宫内膜异位症（总体及III/IV期疾病）之间的全基因组遗传相关性，基于比对至GRCh37参考基因组并限制为HapMap3变异的汇总统计数据。对每种铁生物标志物与子宫内膜异位症联合应用多性状GWAS（MTAG），以增强遗传位点的发现。使用GTEx v8的生殖和铁相关组织以及eQTLGen表达定量性状位点（eQTL）数据的血液对共享位点进行功能注释。使用多个聚类阈值下的全基因组显著变异进行双向孟德尔随机化（MR）分析，以逆方差加权（IVW）为主要方法，敏感性分析包括加权中位数、MR-Egger和MR-PRESSO。主要结果和偶然性的作用 遗传相关性分析提示，子宫内膜异位症的遗传易感性与全身铁可用性较低的谱型相关。具体而言，子宫内膜异位症的遗传易感性与非结合铁结合力（TIBC）较高（rg=0.16，p=4x10-4）相关，同时与转铁蛋白饱和度较低（rg=-0.16，p=0.006）和铁蛋白水平较低（rg=-0.10，p=0.022）相关，这些发现与铁储备减少一致。MTAG识别出8个额外的子宫内膜异位症全基因组显著位点，以及8个与铁生物标志物共享的位点，包括涉及凝血（F5）、先天免疫反应（IL1A）、生殖生物学（WNT4）以及免疫和血管通路（如ABO、STAT6）的区域。孟德尔随机化分析为铁状态与子宫内膜异位症之间的因果关系提供了有限且不一致的证据。尽管逆方差加权（IVW）模型显示铁蛋白水平较高与子宫内膜异位症风险较低之间存在名义关联（OR = 0.85，95% CI 0.76-0.94；p = 0.002），以及子宫内膜异位症遗传易感性与TIBC较高之间存在名义关联（OR = 1.02，95% CI 1.01-1.04；p = 0.006），但这些发现未得到敏感性分析的一致支持。MR-PRESSO识别出少量多效性变异，但去除这些变异并未实质性改变结果。局限性、谨慎原因 铁生物标志物GWAS包括男性和女性，可能掩盖女性特异性效应。数据集可用性将分析限制于欧洲血统，限制了对其他人群的适用性，且仅限于总体和III/IV期子宫内膜异位症，无法评估其他疾病亚型。SNP工具的异质性（由Cochran's Q统计量反映）降低了孟德尔随机化估计的精确度。此外，遗传工具仅解释了铁生物标志物约1.0%至18.8%的方差（取决于聚类阈值），这可能限制了检测因果效应的功效。研究结果的更广泛意义 这些发现表明，子宫内膜异位症在遗传上与全身铁可用性降低和铁稳态改变相关。因此，子宫内膜异位症女性中观察到的全身铁状态较低可能不能仅由月经失血或饮食因素解释，而是反映了潜在的遗传易感性。共享遗传位点提示凝血、ABO生物学和免疫通路是连接铁代谢与子宫内膜异位症的潜在机制。尽管孟德尔随机化未提供一致的因果性证据，但这些发现支持共享遗传结构，并值得使用女性特异性GWAS、精细疾病亚型和多组学方法进一步研究。临床上，这些发现提示子宫内膜异位症女性全身铁状态较低可能反映了已确定的铁缺乏原因之外的因素，包括潜在的遗传易感性。

papers.title: Multisystem Symptom Burden and Functional Impairment in a Specialty Benzodiazepine Taper Cohort
papers.translated_title: 专科苯二氮䓬类药物减量队列中的多系统症状负担与功能损害
papers.author: Madhava, V. S.
papers.summary: Background. Benzodiazepine withdrawal can be prolonged and disabling, with symptoms extending beyond anxiety and insomnia. We characterized symptom burden and functional impairment in a specialty taper cohort and evaluated an exploratory rule for organizing complex, multisystem presentations. Methods. We analyzed cross-sectional intake data from 39 consecutive patients: 37 seeking to begin a supervised taper and two who had completed tapering but remained symptomatic. All 39 returned a 233-item symptom questionnaire, and 38 completed the PROMIS-29 Profile v2.0. Questionnaire items were assigned in advance to five domains: CRH/Adrenergic, Excitatory/Neuroinflammatory, Autonomic, Basal Ganglia-Cerebellar, and MCAS-overlap. Severe symptoms ([≥]7/10) were counted across the first four domains. Patients with three or fewer severe symptoms were classified as Low-symptom; otherwise, the domain with the highest count determined the dominant-axis label, with ties classified as Mixed. MCAS-overlap was coded separately. The categorization was repeated at severity thresholds from [≥]5/10 to [≥]8/10. Results. Patients endorsed a median of 74 symptoms (IQR, 48-24), with a median of 24 rated severe (IQR, 7-42). Thirty-five of 39 patients (89.7%) had severe symptoms in at least two core domains. PROMIS-29 mean T-scores were elevated for Anxiety, Depression, Sleep Disturbance, and Fatigue and were lower for Physical Function and Ability to Participate in Social Roles and Activities; Pain Interference was close to the population mean. At the primary [≥]7/10 severity threshold, 14 patients were classified as CRH/Adrenergic, 14 as Excitatory/Neuroinflammatory, four as Autonomic, and seven as Low-symptom; none were classified as Basal Ganglia-Cerebellar or Mixed. Twenty-two patients (56.4%) met the operational criterion for MCAS-overlap. Agreement with the primary labels was 87.2% at [≥]6/10 and 69.2% at both [≥]5/10 and [≥]8/10 severity thresholds. Conclusions. This cohort had severe, multisystem symptom burden and substantial functional impairment. The five-domain framework provided a structured way to organize these presentations, but the dominant-axis labels were threshold-dependent and should be interpreted as exploratory summaries rather than discrete patient subtypes. Larger longitudinal studies using validated instruments and data-driven methods are needed to determine whether stable symptom subgroups exist.
papers.translated_summary: 背景。苯二氮䓬类药物戒断可能迁延且致残，症状超出焦虑和失眠的范围。我们描述了一个专科减量队列中的症状负担和功能损害，并评估了一种用于组织复杂多系统表现的探索性规则。方法。我们分析了连续39例患者的横断面入组数据：37例寻求开始监督下减量，2例已完成减量但仍存在症状。全部39例返回了一份233项症状问卷，38例完成了PROMIS-29 Profile v2.0。问卷条目预先归入五个域：CRH/肾上腺素能、兴奋性/神经炎症、自主神经、基底节-小脑以及MCAS重叠。前四个域中计数严重症状（[≥]7/10）。严重症状为三项或更少的患者被归类为低症状；否则，计数最高的域决定优势轴标签，并列者归类为混合。MCAS重叠单独编码。在[≥]5/10至[≥]8/10的严重程度阈值下重复该分类。结果。患者中位报告74项症状（IQR，48-24），中位24项被评为严重（IQR，7-42）。39例患者中有35例（89.7%）在至少两个核心域中存在严重症状。PROMIS-29平均T评分在焦虑、抑郁、睡眠障碍和疲劳方面升高，在身体功能和参与社会角色与活动能力方面较低；疼痛干扰接近人群均值。在主要[≥]7/10严重程度阈值下，14例患者被归类为CRH/肾上腺素能，14例为兴奋性/神经炎症，4例为自主神经，7例为低症状；无一例被归类为基底节-小脑或混合。22例患者（56.4%）符合MCAS重叠的操作性标准。与主要标签的一致性在[≥]6/10时为87.2%，在[≥]5/10和[≥]8/10严重程度阈值下均为69.2%。结论。该队列具有严重的多系统症状负担和显著的功能损害。五域框架为组织这些表现提供了结构化方法，但优势轴标签依赖于阈值，应被解释为探索性总结，而非离散的患者亚型。需要采用经过验证的工具和数据驱动方法开展更大规模的纵向研究，以确定是否存在稳定的症状亚组。

papers.title: Not All Entropy Is Equal: Why Representation Matters for Biological Interpretation in Dementia EEG
papers.translated_title: 并非所有熵都等同：为何表征对痴呆脑电的生物解释至关重要
papers.author: Edmonds, V.
papers.summary: Objective: To examine what a dementia-associated electroencephalography (EEG) entropy difference permits us to infer about brain dynamics by testing its dependence on permutation-entropy (PE) representation. Methods: Four PE settings represented identical alpha-band data from 1,177 CAUEEG recordings. Nine duration/filtering specifications, phase reconstruction, controlled signals, age models, and 78 external participants (58 in the AD-control comparison) assessed measurement sensitivity. CAUEEG includes repeated patients without an available linkage key; its statistics describe recordings, and uncertainty estimates assume recording independence. Results: In the original analysis, dementia PE contrasts ranged from d=-0.690 to +0.705. Across nine specifications, sub-cycle PE remained negative (d=-0.729 to -0.576) and coarse-sampled PE positive (+0.625 to +0.712). Cycle-spanning and high-order contrasts remained small. Phase reconstructed 90.2% of ordinal patterns; similarly high agreement occurred after spectral phase randomization. The sample-entropy contrast fell from d=+0.523 to +0.197 with 2 s windows on the same recordings. The external PE profile retained its ordering but did not reproduce the CAUEEG sign reversal. Conclusions: The reversal is stable across the tested processing choices, but a stable contrast does not specify its biological meaning. Phase reconstruction supports a narrowband measurement account; patient-level precision and predictive generalization remain unresolved. Significance: Biological interpretation requires a justified connection between the signal distinctions retained by a representation and the proposed alteration in brain dynamics.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：通过检验痴呆相关脑电图（EEG）熵差异对排列熵（PE）表示的依赖性，考察该差异能让我们对脑动力学推断出什么。方法：四种PE设置表示来自1，177份CAUEEG记录的相同α波段数据。九种时长/滤波规格、相位重建、受控信号、年龄模型以及78名外部参与者（58名参与AD-对照比较）评估了测量敏感性。CAUEEG包含重复患者且无可用关联键；其统计量描述的是记录，不确定性估计假设记录独立。结果：在原始分析中，痴呆PE对比范围为d=-0.690至+0.705。在九种规格中，亚周期PE保持为负（d=-0.729至-0.576），粗采样PE为正（+0.625至+0.712）。跨周期和高阶对比仍然较小。相位重建了90.2%的序数模式；在频谱相位随机化后也出现了类似的高一致性。在相同记录上使用2秒窗口时，样本熵对比从d=+0.523降至+0.197。外部PE轮廓保持了其排序，但未能重现CAUEEG的符号反转。结论：该反转在所测试的处理选择中稳定，但稳定的对比并不能说明其生物学意义。相位重建支持窄带测量解释；患者层面的精确性和预测泛化仍未解决。意义：生物学解释需要所保留的信号区分与所提出的脑动力学改变之间存在有依据的联系。

papers.title: EEG Biomarkers for ATN Classification in Early Alzheimer's disease
papers.translated_title: 早期阿尔茨海默病ATN分类的脑电图生物标志物
papers.author: Braboszcz, C.
papers.summary: INTRODUCTION: Early detection of Alzheimer's disease (AD) remains challenging. EEG offers a scalable, non-invasive tool for patient stratification, but its relationship to ATN-defined staging is poorly understood. METHODS: EEG was recorded in 60 participants (SCD, MCI--, MCI+, N=20 per group) using a battery of tasks (N-back, auditory oddball, 40 Hz ASSR, resting-state). Event-related, spectral, connectivity, and complexity features were extracted, compared across groups, correlated with CSF and plasma biomarkers, and evaluated for classification performance. RESULTS: Multiple EEG features showed discriminatory power among groups and correlated with amyloid and tau biomarkers. MCI-- showed a cortical hyperexcitability profile. EEG added no value for ATN-based discrimination where plasma pTau217 performed near ceiling (AUC=0.96--0.99), but uniquely separated SCD from MCI (EEG AUC {approx} 0.72--0.75) where plasma biomarkers failed (AUC{approx} 0.32--0.33). DISCUSSION: EEG biomarkers capture ATN-stage-dependent neurophysiological signatures, support a non-monotonic model of AD progression, and show promise as a first screening tool where plasma biomarkers are uninformative.
papers.translated_summary: 引言：阿尔茨海默病（AD）的早期检测仍然具有挑战性。脑电图（EEG）为患者分层提供了一种可扩展、非侵入性的工具，但其与ATN定义分期之间的关系尚不清楚。方法：使用一系列任务（N-back、听觉oddball、40 Hz ASSR、静息态）对60名参与者（SCD、MCI--、MCI+，每组N=20）进行了EEG记录。提取了事件相关、频谱、连通性和复杂性特征，在组间进行比较，与脑脊液和血浆生物标志物进行相关性分析，并评估了分类性能。结果：多个EEG特征在组间显示出区分能力，并与淀粉样蛋白和tau生物标志物相关。MCI--显示出皮层过度兴奋特征。在血浆pTau217表现接近天花板（AUC=0.96--0.99）的情况下，EEG对基于ATN的区分没有附加价值，但在血浆生物标志物失败（AUC{approx} 0.32--0.33）的情况下，EEG独特地将SCD与MCI区分开来（EEG AUC {approx} 0.72--0.75）。讨论：EEG生物标志物捕捉了ATN分期依赖的神经生理学特征，支持AD进展的非单调模型，并在血浆生物标志物无法提供信息的情况下显示出作为首选筛查工具的潜力。

papers.title: No Evidence for Increased Platelet Reactivity with Xylitol or Erythritol Sweeteners in Healthy Humans
papers.translated_title: 在健康人群中，没有证据表明木糖醇或赤藓糖醇甜味剂会增加血小板反应性
papers.author: Woelnerhanssen, B. K.
papers.summary: Background: Erythritol and xylitol, naturally present in fruits and vegetables, are widely used as alternative sweeteners with minimal glycemic and insulinemic effects. Both are also produced endogenously, with elevated plasma concentrations reported in metabolic disorders and cardiovascular disease. Recently, two interventional studies reported enhanced platelet aggregation after acute oral intake of erythritol or xylitol, raising concerns about potential prothrombotic effects. We investigated whether acute exposure to erythritol or xylitol increases platelet reactivity in healthy individuals. Methods: We conducted a randomized, single-blind, crossover study in 14 healthy participants who received erythritol (50 g), xylitol (33.5 g), or water. Platelet aggregation was assessed ex vivo, together with circulating markers of platelet activation (P-selectin), endothelial activation (sVCAM-1), and coagulation (D-dimer), as well as plasma erythritol and xylitol concentrations. Complementary in vitro experiments were performed using platelet-rich plasma from 11 healthy participants exposed to increasing concentrations of erythritol or xylitol, followed by assessment of platelet aggregation. Results: Despite substantial increases in circulating erythritol and xylitol concentrations following oral intake, neither erythritol nor xylitol increased ex vivo platelet aggregation compared with water. Consistently, no relevant changes were observed in P-selectin, sVCAM-1, or D-dimer concentrations. Direct in vitro exposure of platelet-rich plasma to increasing concentrations of erythritol or xylitol likewise did not enhance platelet aggregation. Conclusions: In healthy individuals, acute oral intake of erythritol or xylitol did not increase platelet aggregation or circulating markers of platelet activation, endothelial activation, or coagulation. These findings were supported by in vitro experiments showing no direct effect of erythritol or xylitol on platelet aggregation. Our results do not support an acute platelet-activating effect of erythritol or xylitol under the conditions studied. Registration: URL: https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT04966299; Unique identifier: NCT04966299.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：赤藓糖醇和木糖醇天然存在于水果和蔬菜中，作为替代甜味剂被广泛使用，对血糖和胰岛素影响极小。两者也可在体内内源性产生，在代谢紊乱和心血管疾病中报道血浆浓度升高。近期，两项干预性研究报告急性口服摄入赤藓糖醇或木糖醇后血小板聚集增强，引发对其潜在促血栓效应的担忧。我们研究了健康个体急性暴露于赤藓糖醇或木糖醇是否会增加血小板反应性。方法：我们开展了一项随机、单盲、交叉研究，纳入14名健康参与者，分别接受赤藓糖醇（50 g）、木糖醇（33.5 g）或水。通过离体方式评估血小板聚集，同时检测循环中血小板活化标志物（P-选择素）、内皮活化标志物（sVCAM-1）和凝血标志物（D-二聚体），以及血浆赤藓糖醇和木糖醇浓度。另采用11名健康参与者的富血小板血浆进行补充性体外实验，暴露于递增浓度的赤藓糖醇或木糖醇，随后评估血小板聚集。结果：尽管口服摄入后循环赤藓糖醇和木糖醇浓度显著升高，但与水相比，赤藓糖醇和木糖醇均未增加离体血小板聚集。一致地，P-选择素、sVCAM-1或D-二聚体浓度均未观察到相关变化。富血小板血浆直接体外暴露于递增浓度的赤藓糖醇或木糖醇同样未增强血小板聚集。结论：在健康个体中，急性口服摄入赤藓糖醇或木糖醇未增加血小板聚集或循环中血小板活化、内皮活化或凝血标志物。这些发现得到体外实验的支持，表明赤藓糖醇或木糖醇对血小板聚集无直接影响。我们的结果不支持在所研究条件下赤藓糖醇或木糖醇具有急性血小板活化效应。注册：网址：https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT04966299；唯一标识符：NCT04966299。

papers.title: A locally deployable agentic framework for clinical data deidentification
papers.translated_title: 一种可本地部署的用于临床数据去标识化的智能体框架
papers.author: Hirsch, A.
papers.summary: Multimodal clinical data contain identifiers across diverse formats. We developed the Multimodal Anonymizer, a locally deployable framework combining multimodal language models, specialist networks, deterministic transformations and iterative verification. We compared 16 orchestrator configurations using automated evaluation on 250 constructed MIMIC-IV-derived patient bundles with synthetic identifiers. A selected local configuration underwent manual evaluation on these same bundles supplemented with head CT scans, face images, handwritten notes, audio recordings and synthetic German clinical notes from unrelated sources. Separate evaluations used the German GRASCCO corpus and 250 Charite partograms. On this expanded benchmark, patient-level deidentification sensitivity was 98.80% (95% CI, 97.20; 100), per-identifier sensitivity 99.82% (95% CI, 99.76; 99.88), patient-level critical clinical preservation 99.60% (95% CI, 98.80; 100) and the clinical preservation score 99.61% (95% CI, 99.51; 99.71). All partograms met the study-defined deidentification criterion. These findings support feasibility, while constructed bundles, synthetic identifiers, limited natural-data validation and absent component ablations constrain generalizability.
papers.translated_summary: 多模态临床数据包含多种格式的标识符。我们开发了多模态匿名化器，这是一个可本地部署的框架，结合了多模态语言模型、专家网络、确定性变换和迭代验证。我们使用自动化评估，在250个构建的MIMIC-IV衍生患者数据包（含合成标识符）上比较了16种编排器配置。选定的本地配置在这些相同数据包上接受了人工评估，并补充了来自无关来源的头部CT扫描、面部图像、手写笔记、音频录音和合成德语临床笔记。单独评估使用了德语GRASCCO语料库和250份Charite产程图。在这个扩展基准上，患者级去标识化灵敏度为98.80%（95% CI，97.20；100），每标识符灵敏度为99.82%（95% CI，99.76；99.88），患者级关键临床保留率为99.60%（95% CI，98.80；100），临床保留评分为99.61%（95% CI，99.51；99.71）。所有产程图均满足研究定义的去标识化标准。这些发现支持可行性，但构建的数据包、合成标识符、有限的自然数据验证以及缺乏组件消融限制了泛化能力。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal clustering of tuberculosis notifications in Nepal during the COVID-19 pandemic and subsequent recovery: A national space-time scan analysis, 2019-2024
papers.translated_title: 2019-2024年COVID-19大流行及后续恢复期尼泊尔结核病通报的时空聚集性：一项全国时空扫描分析
papers.author: Bisht, N.
papers.summary: The COVID-19 pandemic substantially disrupted tuberculosis (TB) prevention, diagnosis, and treatment services worldwide. Despite increased TB notifications in Nepal during the post-pandemic recovery period, the geographic distribution and temporal clustering of notifications remain poorly understood. This study examined the spatial and temporal patterns of TB notifications across Nepal during the COVID-19 recovery period. We conducted a nationwide retrospective ecological analysis of district-level TB notifications across all 77 districts of Nepal from FY 2019/20 to FY 2023/24. Space-time, purely spatial, and purely temporal scan statistics were performed using a discrete Poisson model in SaTScan. Statistical significance was assessed using Monte Carlo simulation with 999 replications. A total of 172,155 TB cases were notified during the study period. TB notification rates increased by 51%, from 92 to 139 per 100,000 population between FY 2019/20 and FY 2023/24. Four statistically significant high-notification space-time clusters were identified (all p < 0.001). The primary cluster included Kathmandu, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur, Makwanpur, Bara, and Parsa districts during FY 2021/22-FY 2023/24 (RR = 1.60). Additional clusters were identified in western Nepal, the eastern Terai, and Rupandehi district. Purely temporal analysis showed a nationwide increase in notifications during FY 2022/23-FY 2023/24 (RR = 1.26, p = 0.001). TB notifications increased substantially during Nepals post-pandemic recovery period, with marked geographic and temporal heterogeneity. Integrating spatial and temporal surveillance may help identify areas requiring geographically targeted TB control strategies.
papers.translated_summary: COVID-19大流行严重扰乱了全球结核病（TB）的预防、诊断和治疗服务。尽管尼泊尔在大流行后恢复期结核病通报数有所增加，但通报的地理分布和时间聚集性仍知之甚少。本研究考察了COVID-19恢复期尼泊尔全国结核病通报的时空模式。我们对尼泊尔全部77个区从2019/20财年至2023/24财年的区级结核病通报进行了全国性回顾性生态学分析。使用SaTScan中的离散泊松模型进行了时空、纯空间和纯时间扫描统计。采用999次重复的蒙特卡洛模拟评估统计显著性。研究期间共通报172,155例结核病病例。结核病通报率从2019/20财年的每10万人口92例上升至2023/24财年的139例，增幅为51%。共识别出四个具有统计学显著性的高通报时空聚集区（均p < 0.001）。主要聚集区包括加德满都、拉利特普尔、巴克塔普尔、马克万普尔、巴拉和帕尔萨各区，时间为2021/22财年至2023/24财年（RR = 1.60）。其他聚集区位于尼泊尔西部、东部特莱平原和鲁潘德希区。纯时间分析显示，2022/23财年至2023/24财年全国通报数增加（RR = 1.26，p = 0.001）。尼泊尔大流行后恢复期结核病通报数大幅增加，且具有明显的地理和时间异质性。整合空间和时间监测可能有助于识别需要采取地理靶向结核病控制策略的地区。

papers.title: High Schistosomiasis Prevalence in Urban and Rural Primary School Children from Kimpese Health District, Democratic Republic of the Congo
papers.translated_title: 刚果民主共和国金佩塞卫生区城乡小学儿童血吸虫病高感染率
papers.author: Karume, K. L.
papers.summary: Background Schistosomiasis is a parasitic disease caused by flatworms known as schistosomes. The infection cycle starts when people shed eggs through the stool or the urine. Larva infects freshwater snails to later infect humans through the skin during water based activities. Schistosomiasis is commonly associated with rural areas. In this study, we wanted to see if the schistosomiasis distribution is different in rural and urban areas, along with potential risk factors associated with schistosomiasis distribution. Methodology Fresh urine samples were collected from 1,699 school-aged children (5 - 15 years old) in urban and rural sites in the Kimpese health district. Prevalence of haematobium and mansoni schistosomiasis was determined using, respectively, the urine sedimentation and the Point-of-Care Circulating Cathodic Antigen test with a quantitative estimate of infection intensity obtained with an RDT-Reader. Collected risk factors were tested for association with schistosomiasis infection and its intensity. Results The overall prevalence of schistosomiasis found in urban and rural areas was 75% and 82% respectively, with higher prevalence of S. mansoni in rural schools, and higher S. haematobium prevalence in urban schools. The difference in total prevalence between schools in urban and rural areas was significant, X2 (1, N = 1699) = 13.03, p = .0003. S. mansoni intensity of infection was also higher in rural children (mean = 162 mV) compared to those in urban areas (mean = 76 mV) (p < 2e-16). Male gender, washing dishes in the river, and swimming were associated with schistosomiasis in urban areas. Age, Springs, and rivers were significant factors in rural sites. Age, river, and washing dishes in the river were factors associated with the intensity of infection. Conclusion Our results showed very high prevalence in both rural and urban areas, which implies that control programs should consider them with the same interest and also revise control strategies.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 血吸虫病是一种由称为血吸虫的扁形动物引起的寄生虫病。感染循环始于人们通过粪便或尿液排出虫卵。幼虫感染淡水螺，随后在水上活动期间通过皮肤感染人类。血吸虫病通常与农村地区相关。在本研究中，我们希望了解血吸虫病在农村和城市地区的分布是否存在差异，以及与血吸虫病分布相关的潜在风险因素。方法 从Kimpese卫生区城市和农村地区的1，699名学龄儿童（5-15岁）中采集新鲜尿液样本。分别使用尿液沉淀法和即时检测循环阴极抗原试验测定埃及血吸虫和曼氏血吸虫血吸虫病的患病率，并通过RDT-Reader获得感染强度的定量估计。对收集的风险因素与血吸虫感染及其强度之间的关联进行了检验。结果 城市和农村地区血吸虫病的总体患病率分别为75%和82%，其中农村学校曼氏血吸虫患病率较高，城市学校埃及血吸虫患病率较高。城市和农村地区学校之间的总患病率差异显著，X2（1，N = 1699）= 13.03，p = .0003。农村儿童曼氏血吸虫感染强度也高于城市地区儿童（均值 = 162 mV 对 均值 = 76 mV）（p < 2e-16）。男性、在河中洗碗和游泳与城市地区血吸虫病相关。年龄、泉水和河流是农村地区的重要因素。年龄、河流和在河中洗碗是与感染强度相关的因素。结论 我们的结果显示，农村和城市地区的患病率都非常高，这意味着控制项目应以同等重视程度考虑这两个地区，并且还应修订控制策略。
